title: Memory observation
description: PERD §33: one append-only operational-memory row. Data, never authority (REQ-MEM-001); free text is never stored. The PERD fixes the envelope and says 'typed JSON, per a kind-specific schema' without listing any kind's fields, so `observation` is held to typed scalars only (codes, IDs, integers, booleans) until the owner of each kind supplies its field list. Version 2 (Founder decision D10, 7 Nov 2026): the case reference of v1 is the member provenance_ref; observation fields stay typed scalars.

subject_ref.description: An opaque reference to what the observation is about (a capability, source, intent node or case ID).

recorded_by.description: The power or tool that recorded it, as a code.

provenance_ref.description: What this observation came from or produced, as a case or source ID (AGENT-23 for a regression link).
